item.title: Website Usability Review and Testing
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | I'm seeking a detailed review and usability test of my website. The main focus should be on evaluating how easy the site is to navigate, especially for new visitors.
Key Areas to Test: - User-friendliness: Assess how easy it is to find information and move between pages. - Form functionality: Test the ease of filling in forms, signing up, and contacting me.
The ideal freelancer should have: - Experience in UX/UI testing - Attention to detail - Ability to provide a comprehensive report with actionable suggestions

item.title: Enhance PHP SuperAdmin Features

item.title: OSHA 30 Construction Attendance Help
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m enrolled in the OSHA 30-hour Construction online course and need the full 30 hours of verified screen time to earn my card. My schedule makes it hard to stay in front of the computer that long, so I’m bringing in support to keep the course session active and properly documented.
Your role is straightforward: • Remain logged into the training portal (access provided through remote desktop or direct credentials). • Keep the screen active, answer the quick pop-up checks, and click “Next” whenever a section unlocks so the timer never pauses. • Maintain a simple Google Sheet that tracks each module’s start/finish time, percentage complete, and any notes on outstanding quizzes.
We’ll agree on a schedule that totals the required 30 seat hours—ideally spread over the next week—so you can stay online during those blocks. The system logs out after roughly ten minutes of inactivity, so consistent mouse movement and prompt responses are essential.
Deliverables 1. Portal screenshot (or downloadable report) showing a full 30 recorded hours. 2. Completed progress tracker. 3. Brief daily summary of what was covered and what remains.
Reliability and stable internet are the main requirements; no specialized OSHA knowledge is necessary. If you can commit to the time blocks and meticulous tracking, let’s get this course finished.

item.title: Custom Luxury Fashion E-Commerce
item.description:
30-250 USD | I want to launch a premium online clothing store built entirely from scratch—no WordPress, no Shopify, and no off-the-shelf templates. The look and feel must echo high-end labels: minimalist layouts, generous white space, neutral colour palettes, and crisp typography that lets product imagery breathe.
Core shopping experience • Shoppers need to browse effortlessly by category, size, and colour. • They must be able to add items to a cart, pay online, and receive real-time order confirmation. • Registered accounts are essential so customers can track orders and curate favourites for later.
Payments At launch the checkout has to support credit and debit cards, Cash-on-Delivery, and UPI. Please implement a well-documented gateway so I can add PayPal or Apple/Google Pay later without a full rebuild.
Admin side I need a secure dashboard where I can upload products with variants, set stock levels, manage orders and returns, run discount codes, and view basic sales analytics. Role-based access control is a must.
Device coverage & performance The site should be fully responsive, load quickly on 3G, and follow SEO best practices (clean URLs, meta tags, structured data). Core Web Vitals scores will be part of acceptance testing.
Tech expectations Use a modern stack you’re comfortable maintaining—React or Vue on the front end, Node, Laravel, or an equivalent robust framework on the back end, with MySQL/PostgreSQL for data and Git for version control. Please avoid bloated libraries and keep the codebase well commented.
Deliverables (hand-off ready) 1. Production-ready storefront and admin panel deployed to my VPS 2. Source code in a private Git repo with setup instructions 3. Database schema and seed data 4. Payment gateway configuration keys abstracted to .env 5. Short video walkthrough showing product upload, checkout flow, and order management
Acceptance criteria • All user flows above complete without errors on Chrome, Safari, and mobile browsers • Checkout processes real test transactions for cards, COD, and UPI • Lighthouse performance score ≥ 90 on desktop and mobile home page • Admin roles restrict access correctly (tested with dummy accounts)
If any requirement is unclear, let’s iron it out early so the build stays clean and elegant from day one.

item.title: Digital Marketing Manager for Toronto Businesses
item.description:
250-750 CAD | Hi,
I'm looking for someone to manage all the digital marketing and websites for two established businesses in Toronto, Canada.
I'm interested in a long-term, part-time arrangement, approximately 15–20 hours per week.
Before moving forward, I have a few questions:
1. Experience: How many years have you worked in digital marketing? Have you managed marketing for Canadian or American businesses?
2. English: Are you fluent in written and spoken English? All our marketing and customer-facing content will be in English.
3. Google Ads: Can you create, manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including keywords, targeting, budgets and conversion tracking?
4. Google Ads problems: Can you troubleshoot disapproved ads, website policy violations and deal directly with Google Ads support? We currently have an unresolved Google Ads policy issue.
5. SEO: Can you handle all aspects of SEO, including technical SEO, local SEO, Google Search Console and improving our rankings in Toronto?
6. Google Business Profile: Can you manage and optimize both companies' Google Business Profiles and help improve our visibility on Google Maps?
7. Websites: Can you maintain, update, troubleshoot and improve our websites, including working with WordPress and Hostinger hosting?
8. Social media: Can you completely manage Facebook and Instagram, including creating content, graphics, posts and paid advertising campaigns?
9. Content creation: Would you create the advertising content and graphics yourself, or would we need to provide everything?
10. Results: Can you show me examples of businesses you've managed and measurable results you've achieved, particularly leads generated through Google Ads or SEO?
11. Independent management: Are you comfortable taking responsibility for everything website and digital marketing related, identifying problems and making recommendations without needing daily instructions?
12. Availability: Are you available for approximately 15–20 hours weekly? Would you be working independently or using other freelancers?
13. Reporting: Can you provide weekly progress updates and monthly reports showing website traffic, advertising costs, phone calls, leads and results?
14. Pricing: What fixed monthly fee would you charge to manage both businesses? Would everything mentioned above be included, or would certain services cost extra?
15. Trial period: Would you be interested in starting with a paid 30-day trial so we can evaluate your work before entering a long-term arrangement?
I'm looking for one reliable person who can take ownership of our entire online presence, not just someone who posts on social media.
Please let me know which of these responsibilities you can personally handle and which would require additional assistance.
Thank you.

item.title: Water Treatment Service Website Build
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need a clean, conversion-focused website modeled closely on https://michiganwaterpros.com/ for my local water-treatment business. The core pages will mirror the example’s structure—clear service sections that explain what we do and a straightforward contact form on every page—so visitors can reach out without hunting for the right button.
Beyond that baseline, I want an online booking / quote request form built in, letting customers choose a service, pick a preferred time-frame, and send the request straight to my inbox. The two primary services we must highlight are (1) water testing and complete filtration system installation, and (2) water softeners, reverse osmosis units, and ongoing maintenance. Everything else on the site should steer leads toward requesting one of those options.
Visual style should stay professional and trustworthy—think blues, clean typography, simple iconography—yet you’re free to refine the layout or propose a more modern framework as long as it stays fast, mobile-responsive, and easy for me to update.
Deliverables • Custom WordPress (or comparable CMS) theme replicating the reference site’s user flow • Service pages for the offerings above, each with clear calls to action • Embedded contact form plus a separate booking / quote request workflow tied to email notifications • Basic on-page SEO (titles, meta, schema for local service) • Training hand-off or short video walkthrough so I can edit text and images myself
If you have recent examples of similar local-service sites—especially in plumbing or water treatment—feel free to point me to them when you reply.

item.title: Squarespace Accounting Website Build
item.description:
250-750 USD | I have a fresh Squarespace account ready to go and all the copy and imagery organised; what I need is a skilled Squarespace designer-builder to turn those assets into a polished public-facing site for my new accounting firm. The site’s core purpose is to explain our services and establish instant credibility, so clean layout, reassuring visuals and clear calls-to-action are essential.
Content you’ll receive from me: professionally written text and curated photos. Content you’ll create: an intuitive, mobile-friendly Squarespace layout that highlights our three key offerings—Tax preparation and filing, Bookkeeping and payroll, and Business accounting and advisory—in a way that speaks directly to small-business owners.
Key pieces I expect back: • A compelling home page that introduces the firm and builds trust • Individual service sections that make each offering easy to understand • A simple contact form (no booking system needed right now) • Basic SEO settings filled out in Squarespace (titles, descriptions, image alt text) • Connection of our domain and basic on-page analytics set-up
Everything must be built inside my Squarespace login so I can maintain it afterward. Keep the style professional, modern and approachable; think subtle colour palette, crisp typography and plenty of white space. If you have relevant Squarespace portfolio pieces, please mention them when you respond—seeing work aimed at small-business audiences will help me pick quickly.

item.title: Senior React Full-Stack Maintenance Partner
item.description:
250-750 USD | Job Title: Senior Full-Stack Developer "React" Needed for Ongoing Monthly Website Maintenance
We are seeking a highly experienced developer to maintain OwnerFinancing.ai, an existing real estate marketplace. This is an ongoing monthly engagement for a dependable professional who can take responsibility for keeping the website stable, secure, fast, and functioning correctly.
We want a developer who can diagnose problems, implement reliable fixes, and communicate clearly with the owner.
Monthly Responsibilities
Monitor website availability, application errors, and performance.
Diagnose and fix frontend, backend, database, and integration issues.
Maintain existing registration, login, property listing, search, messaging, and subscription functionality.
Resolve mobile usability problems and broken pages, links, images, or forms.
Maintain dependencies and address relevant security updates.
Monitor scheduled jobs, email delivery, and existing third-party integrations.
Maintain backups and periodically verify that restoration works.
Preserve technical SEO essentials, including metadata, redirects, canonical URLs, and sitemap functionality.
Test changes before deployment and maintain a reliable rollback process.
Provide a monthly report covering completed work, outstanding issues, hours used, and recommended priorities.
Required Experience
Strong experience maintaining live, database-driven web applications.
Ability to work confidently across frontend, backend, database, and hosting environments.
Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills.
Experience with authentication, payments, APIs, and production deployments.
Strong understanding of application security and performance.
Clear written communication and dependable availability.
Please review the existing codebase and confirm the technology stack before finalizing your maintenance proposal. An existing website audit will be available to help establish priorities.
Working Arrangement
We prefer a monthly retainer with clearly defined included hours, responsibilities, and response times. Please specify emergency support availability and the rate for work beyond the monthly allowance.
Additional feature development will be agreed and priced separately. All code, accounts, documentation, and project assets must remain under our ownership.
Include in Your Application
Two or three relevant websites you have personally maintained, explaining your responsibilities.
An example of a difficult production issue you diagnosed and resolved.
Your proposed monthly fee, included hours, and additional hourly rate.
Your working hours, time zone, and response time for critical issues.
Your approach to monitoring, backups, testing, and deployments.
Whether you will personally perform the work.
Your earliest availability.
We are looking for a long-term technical partner with proven production experience.

item.title: Shopify Dropshipping Store Setup
item.description:
100-350 USD | Looking for a Shopify expert to build a winning dropshipping store in the sleep and rest category
I’m looking for an experienced Shopify expert to design and launch a dropshipping store with 50 winning products already loaded. I want a store that is ready to sell from day one, not a template I have to finish myself. I also need someone who can help me get it in front of customers once it’s live.
What I need
-A clean, modern, premium Shopify store with a strong brand feel -Research on winning products in the sleep and rest category (sleepwear, loungewear, sleep accessories, aromas, sleep tech), backed by real demand, healthy margins and good reviews, not just whatever is trending -Winning products added to the store with polished listings, photos and copy that sell -DTC dropshipping set up with reliable, credible suppliers, including sample orders, shipping times and quality checks -Help with marketing, such as a launch plan, ad and content guidance and getting my first sales -Ongoing support after launch to refine the store, swap out weak products and scale the ones that work
What I’m looking for in you
A proven track record of Shopify store design, with examples of stores you’ve built Real experience in product research and dropshipping, ideally with results you can share A good understanding of branding and what makes a store feel trustworthy and premium Experience helping stores get traffic and sales, not just looking good Clear communication and a willingness to support the store long term
To apply
Please send links to stores you’ve built, a short note on how you find winning products, and how you would approach marketing for a new store.

item.title: Comprehensive WordPress Health Check & Fix
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I need a one-off, end-to-end inspection of my WordPress site to confirm that every setting, plugin, page, and interaction is running exactly as it should. Please review the active theme and all plugins for version conflicts, security risks, and best-practice configuration, then move on to test contact forms, email delivery, user registration and login flows.
From there, click through every page, validate internal and external links, check responsive behaviour on mobile and tablet, and benchmark overall site speed—tuning caching or image optimisation if you spot bottlenecks.
If you encounter an issue, fix it on the spot rather than waiting for approval; only flag anything truly major that falls outside a normal tune-up.
Deliverables • A fully functional, error-free site. • A brief changelog of the tweaks and fixes applied.
You’ll receive temporary WordPress admin (and cPanel/FTP if needed) the moment we start. Let me know your turnaround time—I’d like this wrapped up in the next couple of days.

item.title: Flutter Developer for Real Estate CRM
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | DH Broker CRM is a mobile CRM built for individual real estate brokers in the U.S. market. Each broker logs in and manages their own client pipeline — contact info, income, city/region, property type, buy/rent intent, and a 5-stage sales funnel (Lead → Contact Made → Visited Property → Proposal → Closed) — plus document uploads (photos/PDFs) per client. It's a solo-built, working app that's functional but pre-launch (not yet published to the Play Store), and we're looking for a developer to take it from "working prototype" to a product we keep building on.
The existing code is clean and reasonably small (~3,500 lines of Dart), with no legacy mess to untangle — a good base for someone who wants to own a project rather than patch one.
Known gaps / near-term housekeeping
- No in-app PDF preview (only images preview today) - Firebase Storage is pinned to a Blaze (pay-as-you-go) plan that hasn't been finalized — document upload isn't fully live yet - Thin automated test coverage (one widget test file) - No version control set up yet — this will need to be established early (we're flexible on GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket) - Not yet submitted to the Play Store (signing config scaffolded, not finalized)
What we're looking for
This isn't just a punch-list job — we want someone who can take ownership and help extend the product, not just finish it. Examples of the kind of feature work on the table (open to discussion/prioritization together, not a fixed spec):
- Multi-broker/team visibility (e.g., a broker-office admin view) - Reminders/notifications (follow-up nudges on stale leads) - Visit/appointment scheduling tied to the funnel - Reporting/analytics (conversion rates by stage, source, region) - In-app PDF viewer; improved offline support - Possible iOS release down the line
We'll also need the housekeeping items above handled along the way (currency/locale alignment, tests, version control, Storage/Blaze finalization, Play Store submion growing the app, not just shipping whatexists. Requirements
- Strong hands-on experience with Flutter/Dart in production apps - Solid Firebase experience: Firestore data modeling, security rules, Auth, Storage - Comfortable with Riverpod (or similar state management) and go_router (or similar declarative routing) - Experience with Android release builds (signing, app bundles, Play Console submission) - Comfortable setting up things like version control and basic test coverage on a project that doesn't have them yet
Nice to have
- Experience with real estate / sales-pipeline CRM products, especially U.S.-market concepts like MLS data or lead-source tracking - Experience with SMS/notification integrations (e.g., Twilio) for lead follow-up - CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, Codemagic, etc.) - iOS build/release experience

item.title: Squarespace Page Setup Help
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I have a Squarespace site that is almost there, but the page structure still feels rough. I need a Squarespace-savvy hand to step in and properly set up and arrange the core pages so everything reads smoothly and looks cohesive on desktop and mobile.
Pages in scope: • Home • About • Contact • Services / Products
The build is already on Squarespace; you’ll be working directly inside the Fluid Engine editor. Your focus is layout, navigation flow, section arrangement, and any light styling tweaks needed to make the pages consistent with the existing brand assets I’ll supply (logo, colors, fonts, and any ready-to-use images or copy).
Deliverables I’d like returned: • Fully arranged versions of the four pages above, ready to publish • Updated site navigation reflecting the new page order • Responsive checks so each page looks clean on tablets and phones • A brief hand-off note summarising changes and where to edit content in the future
If a quick CSS adjustment or branded button style helps pull everything together, feel free to apply it—it’s all about getting the site launch-ready without a full redesign.

item.title: WordPress PHP Version Upgrade
item.description:
30-250 USD | My WordPress site is still running on an outdated PHP build and my host is pressing me to move up to a current, supported release. I’m looking for someone who can log in to the server, flip the site to the latest stable PHP (8.x or whatever you recommend), and make sure the front-end and wp-admin both load without any fatal errors.
Scope is intentionally narrow: the job stops at changing the PHP version itself. Core, theme, or plugin updates and in-depth compatibility debugging are not required; I only need the version switched and a quick confirmation that the site still works.
Deliverables • Production site running on the new PHP version • Screenshot (phpinfo() or WordPress Site Health) proving the upgrade • Brief note confirming a basic smoke test passed
I’ll supply control-panel or SSH access as soon as we start.

item.title: Clean Portfolio & Blog Website
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | I’m ready to launch a small website whose sole purpose is to let me share information, post regular blogs, and showcase a personal portfolio. The visual style has to be simple, clean, modern, and unquestionably professional, with smooth responsiveness on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Here’s what I need you to handle from start to finish: • Design a light, contemporary interface that aligns with the brief. • Build the site on a user-friendly CMS (WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace—or propose another if it achieves the same ease of editing). • Configure the blog section and a dedicated portfolio area so I can add content without touching code. • Launch the site on my domain, ensuring performance, basic on-page SEO, and security settings are in place.
Good communication and realistic, timely milestones are essential. Please keep your pricing reasonable and transparent; an outline of costs per phase will help me compare proposals quickly.
When you reply, include: • Links to two or three live sites that show a minimal, modern aesthetic. • A brief overview of your chosen tech stack. • An estimated timeline for first draft and final delivery. • Your fee structure, plus any optional post-launch support.
I’m prepared to move forward as soon as I find the right partner, so the faster you can deliver while maintaining quality, the better. Looking forward to seeing your work and discussing how we can bring this site to life.

item.title: Arabic-English Live Chat Support Specialist (preferably living in Egypt)
item.description:

item.title: Set Up 20 Shopify Bundles
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need the first twenty bundle “projects” from my supplier’s website recreated on my Shopify store. You’ll work inside the bundle app that is already installed, copy over only the bundle items and the bundle price, and then apply my percentage markup before you publish each one. The goal is to have every bundle appear exactly as it does on the supplier’s site—same products grouped together, same featured photo where possible—while reflecting the new price automatically calculated with the markup.
You will receive the supplier link and the required markup percentage as soon as we start. All work happens in my existing theme and bundle app, so no extra installs or theme edits should be necessary. Once the first twenty bundles are live and checked for accuracy, we can talk about adding more. eg: https://b2b.cc-craft.co.uk/wooden-elves-with-articulated-heads-and-limbs
I need 1 example done before I can proceed with the milestone.

item.title: Complete Website Redesign for Conversions
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I need my entire website rebuilt from the ground up with one clear objective: generating more enquiries and sales. Every page, from the landing screen to the checkout or contact flow, should guide visitors smoothly toward taking action.
The current site already has content and branding in place, but the structure, visuals, and user experience feel dated. I’m open to the platform or stack you feel is best—WordPress, Webflow, or a custom build—as long as the result is fast-loading, fully responsive, and easy for me to update later. Strong on-page SEO practices, clear calls-to-action, and straightforward analytics tracking are must-haves so we can see the uplift in conversions right away.
This is time-sensitive. I’d like to move quickly, agree on wireframes, and get a polished, live site without delay. If you’ve led similar end-to-end redesigns and can demonstrate measurable improvements, let’s discuss your approach and how soon you can start.

item.title: WordPress Review Plugin Development
item.description: 5000-10000 GBP | Senior WordPress/PHP developer needed to build a custom multi-criteria review plugin, integrating with Bricks Builder and ACF. Features include half-point scoring, moderated reviews and edits, photo uploads, member dashboards, business replies, rating-based listing rankings and migration from an existing review plugin. Initially seeking indicative fixed-price quotes and examples of similar work.

item.title: Online Service Booking Website
item.description:
250-750 USD | The core objective is simple: give my customers a smooth way to purchase and instantly pay for the services I offer. I need a modern, mobile-friendly site that showcases each service on its own page, funnels visitors to a “Book & Pay” button, and completes the transaction through a secure gateway such as Stripe or PayPal.
While I’m not asking users to pick dates or send requests at this stage, please build the site on a platform that lets me switch on time-slot selection later without a full rebuild. Good UX, clear calls-to-action, and fast load times are essential.
Pages I know I’ll need are Home, Services, About, Contact, plus a lightweight blog or news section for basic SEO. A contact form, Google Analytics setup, and on-page optimisation for my main keywords should be included so the site is ready to rank.
Deliverables • Fully responsive website deployed to my domain • Secure online payment integration tested end-to-end • Admin dashboard with clear instructions so I can add or edit services myself • One round of revisions after first draft goes live • Final hand-off with brief video or PDF walkthrough of key workflows
If you have a preferred stack—WordPress + WooCommerce, Shopify, Webflow, or a lightweight custom build—let me know why it’s the best fit. Clean code, future scalability, and clear communication are what matter most to me.

item.title: WordPress Developer & Web Project Lead (Remote, Long-Term)
item.description:

This role involves building and maintaining WordPress sites, addressing critical technical SEO issues, and managing site security and hosting.

Develop and maintain WordPress websites using Elementor, Gutenberg/FSE, and custom PHP solutions.
Implement technical SEO fixes, including site speed optimization, schema markup, managing redirects, and optimizing internal linking structures.
Oversee site security and hosting environments, specifically with WP Engine and Cloudflare.
Lead web project requests from end-to-end, collaborating closely with our SEO team to ensure seamless integration and performance.

Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in WordPress development.
Strong working knowledge of technical SEO principles and best practices.
Experience with AI coding tools is a plus (e.g., Claude Code).
Professional proficiency in Spanish and English.
Proactive, reliable, and detail-oriented work ethic.

Type: Ongoing monthly contract position.

Compensation: Around $2,500 USD per month.

item.title: Build Engaging Website Sections
item.description:
250-750 CAD | Our website is hosted, developed and maintained by one of our members, but who is now temporarily unavailable. The website uses Divi Builder and Word Press. We wish to add some pages to the website. We have content ready (photos and documents). One new page would be for a photo library through the years. A second section would be for members only, so that we can post meeting agendas and documents of that sort. A third page would be a monthly calendar, where we can add our events each month. We decided against having online registration for programs on our website for now.
I believe that if these pages were set up, we could learn to maintain the calendar and add or delete documents and photos.
The board would prefer a written proposal from you including # hours, what you would do and your cost estimate. Also include number of edits you will do and some examples of similar work you have done. Our budget is small since we are a small non-profit group.
Thanks again and we are looking forward to hearing from you.

item.title: Bubble Web App, Subscriptions
item.description:
15-25 AUD/hr | I need a customer-facing web app built in Bubble that feels fast, modern, and reliable for an Australian audience. Core functionality centres on two things: accepting recurring subscriptions and letting users place and manage bookings or orders. The payment flow must be seamless (Stripe is fine) and automatically handle plan changes, cancellations, and failed charges.
Within Bubble I already have the branding assets; what I lack is the full database structure, responsive pages, and all the workflows that tie user accounts, subscription status, and booking logic together. Clear, well-named custom states and reusable elements are important so the app can be scaled later without confusion.
Once development is complete I will test in a staging environment; when everything passes we’ll push live together and transfer editor rights. Please share recent Bubble projects that demonstrate similar subscription or booking flows and confirm you’re comfortable collaborating during AEST business hours.

item.title: ELR Shooter Profile Webpage
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I have the words, images, and links ready—I just need them woven into a striking single-page site that persuades potential sponsors to work with me. The content includes my written ELR (Extreme Long Range) shooting story, high-resolution photos, a few graphics, links to videos and social channels, plus a list of equipment, brands, and current supporters.
Here’s what I’m after: a bold, rugged layout that instantly feels at home on an outdoor shooting range yet still looks polished enough for a boardroom decision-maker. Front and center should be my competition results and notable shooting achievements, followed by an engaging media gallery and a dedicated section outlining the gear I run. Clear calls-to-action—such as a contact button or download-ready sponsor deck—need to encourage partnership inquiries.
You’re free to build in pure HTML/CSS/JS or a lightweight framework as long as the final page is:
• Fully responsive and fast-loading on mobile and desktop • Optimised for basic on-page SEO (title, meta, open-graph tags) • Easy for me to tweak copy or swap images later (well-commented code or simple CMS block is fine) • Delivered as a clean folder of assets that I can drop onto my hosting without extra setup
Send back the finished page, source files, and brief instructions for future edits, and I’ll supply all copy, images, and links the moment we start.

item.title: WordPress Content & Social Media Support
item.description: 2-8 USD/hr | We are a small residential cleaning business serving customers in Massachusetts. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented freelancer to publish blog articles on our WordPress website and manage our three existing social media accounts. We will provide the article text. You will handle WordPress formatting and publishing, images, internal linking, basic on-page SEO, and social media scheduling. For privacy reasons, business identifying information and account links will be shared with shortlisted candidates during the interview process. Workload and Budget • Hourly rate: $5/hour • Initial trial: 4 weeks • Maximum workload: 8 hours per week • Weekly budget: $40 • Expected output: 2 published articles per week and approximately 3 posts per social media platform per week. Please confirm that you can complete the work within this schedule and budget. Hours must be tracked, and additional hours require approval in advance. 1. WordPress Blog Publishing Publish two articles per week using our existing WordPress website. We will supply the article text. Your responsibilities include: • Format articles with readable paragraphs, headings, lists, and appropriate spacing. • Find suitable images or create relevant images using AI. • Use royalty-free image sources such as: o https://www.pexels.com/ o https://unsplash.com/ o https://pixabay.com/ • Verify applicable image licenses and keep records of image sources. • Optimize images, use descriptive filenames, and add useful alt text. • Add a featured image and other relevant images as needed. • Write an appropriate SEO title and meta description using the existing SEO plugin. • Use one clear H1 heading and logical H2/H3 subheadings. • Check formatting, spelling, and links before publishing. • Provide the live URL for each published article. Articles should provide helpful information to homeowners about residential house cleaning. Images should primarily show indoor cleaning, including kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas. item.title: # WordPress Drone Photography & Videography Website — Mechanicsville Aerial - Fully Hosted and Ready to Launch -- 2
item.description:
30-250 USD | PROJECT: WordPress Drone Photography Website — Mechanicsville Aerial
PROJECT OVERVIEW
I need a professional, fully functional WordPress website for Mechanicsville Aerial, my drone photography and videography business located in Mechanicsville, Virginia.

I have already paid for a confidentiality agreement. The developer must honor its terms and protect my business information, media, and project materials.
1. WEBSITE DESIGN
Create a modern, professional, mobile-friendly website that works well on computers, tablets, and smartphones.
Include: - Home page - Photography gallery - Video gallery - Services page - Request a Quote / Check Availability page - About page - Contact page - Privacy policy and other necessary standard pages
The design should emphasize attractive aerial imagery, simple navigation, fast loading, and clear calls to action.
2. PHOTOGRAPHY AND VIDEO
The website must accommodate at least 200 photographs, with original files potentially 48 MB each, and at least 75 video clips approximately eight seconds long.
Provide sufficient storage, bandwidth, backups, and efficient media delivery. Use optimized images, thumbnails, and compressed video previews to maintain performance while preserving my original high-resolution files.
The site must support adding more media over time. Explain storage limits, video hosting arrangements, bandwidth limitations, and any additional charges. I must retain control of my original media and any third-party hosting accounts.
3. EASY ADMINISTRATION
I must be able to manage the website without programming knowledge.
Provide a simple WordPress administration interface that allows me to: - Upload, publish, replace, and delete photographs and videos. - Organize galleries into categories. - Edit page content, services, and contact information. - Manage quote requests and customer inquiries. - View and manage email subscribers.
Provide written instructions or a short tutorial showing me how to perform these tasks.
4. QUOTE REQUESTS AND CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION
Visitors must be able to inquire about drone photography and videography services and request pricing or availability.
The form should collect name, email, optional phone number, requested service, project location, preferred date, and project details.
When a request is submitted: - I receive an email notification at my designated business email. - The customer receives an automatic acknowledgment. - The inquiry is saved securely in WordPress. - I can review and track inquiries through the administration area. - I can respond to customers through the website's administration interface using integrated email functionality. - I can review previous inquiries and responses.
Include spam protection and test all functions before launch.
5. EMAIL COLLECTION AND MARKETING
Include an optional newsletter signup form to collect email addresses from prospective customers and existing customers who want business updates.
Provide subscriber management, exportable email lists, appropriate consent language, and unsubscribe functionality. Quote requests must not automatically enroll customers in marketing emails without appropriate consent.
Identify any additional email marketing service fees.
6. BUSINESS EMAIL AND DOMAIN
Configure the website to work with my existing MECHANICSVILLEAERIAL.COM domain and professional email.
Integrate my current email provider where possible, or recommend an appropriate business email service. Configure and test email delivery, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records where applicable.
Test inquiry notifications, customer acknowledgments, and replies.
My domain and existing email accounts must remain under my control. Do not transfer, cancel, or disrupt existing services without my approval.
7. SEO AND SOCIAL MEDIA
Implement sound technical, on-page, and local SEO practices to help attract customers in Mechanicsville, Richmond, Hanover County, and surrounding Virginia communities.
Include: - Search-friendly page titles, descriptions, headings, and URLs. - XML sitemap and descriptive image alt text. - Mobile optimization and good page performance. - Appropriate local business structured data. - Google Search Console and analytics integration where available. - Social media sharing links and attractive previews. - Clear quote-request calls to action.
Use relevant terms naturally, including drone photography, aerial photography, drone videography, real estate aerial photography, and Mechanicsville, Virginia.
Optimize the website for search visibility and social sharing. No guaranteed search rankings or social media exposure are expected.
8. FUTURE ONLINE PAYMENTS
Online payments are not required at launch. However, use a maintainable WordPress architecture that will allow a secure payment gateway and future service deposits or payments to be added without rebuilding the website.
Do not activate paid payment services without my approval.
9. HOSTING, SECURITY, AND LAUNCH
This is a turnkey project. I require a fully functional, hosted website live on MECHANICSVILLEAERIAL.COM before final acceptance, not merely website files or a design.
The developer must: - Configure suitable WordPress hosting, domain connection, and SSL/HTTPS. - Install and configure WordPress, the theme, and necessary plugins. - Implement appropriate security and automated backups. - Configure email and inquiry notifications. - Test the website on desktop and mobile devices. - Test galleries, video playback, forms, and email communication. - Deliver a complete website backup and restoration instructions. - Provide administrator access and operating instructions. - Identify all paid themes, plugins, licenses, hosting plans, and recurring charges.
Disclose all ongoing costs and hosting limitations before work begins.
10. OWNERSHIP AND CONFIDENTIALITY
I require full ownership and administrative control of the completed website and all deliverables, subject to applicable third-party licenses and the project agreement.
The domain must remain in my account. Hosting and related accounts must be registered in my name or transferred to my control.
Upon final payment, provide: - Complete WordPress website files and database. - Custom graphics and assets created for the project. - Administrator credentials and access to relevant accounts. - A complete downloadable website backup. - Operating and restoration instructions. - A list of plugins, themes, licenses, subscriptions, and renewal costs. - The agreed ownership and usage rights for custom work.
I must be able to hire another developer without being locked into proprietary arrangements. Do not retain exclusive control over the domain, hosting, website, or customer information. Honor the existing confidentiality agreement.
11. ACCEPTANCE REQUIREMENTS
The project is complete only when the website is live, functional, and under my control.
Before final acceptance, demonstrate that: 1. The domain opens securely. 2. Photo galleries and videos work - Items in photo and video should be watermarked and have a price tag so that visitors can purchase COPIES of items in the galleries photo or video clip. 3. I can add and remove media without programming. 4. Quote requests are stored and email notifications work. 5. I can respond to customers through the website administration interface. 6. Email collection, consent, and unsubscribe functions work. 7. Business email integration is tested. 8. SEO basics and social sharing previews are configured. 9. Backups, documentation, and administrator access are delivered. 10. Storage limits, ongoing expenses, and licenses are documented. 11. Ownership and confidentiality requirements are satisfied.

Scope • Design a modern, mobile-first storefront that reflects the Rakib brand. • Set up product catalogue, secure checkout, multiple payment gateways (major cards, PayPal), and basic shipping rules. • Integrate essential features such as inventory management, order tracking, promotional codes, newsletter signup, and Google Analytics. • Configure on-page SEO fundamentals and ensure page-load times stay under three seconds on mobile and desktop. • Provide admin credentials, deployment documentation, and a brief hand-off session so we can manage products and content ourselves.
Milestones Feel free to suggest your own split, but I’m thinking something like: 25 % UI/UX & wireframes → 40 % core development → 25 % testing & refinements → 10 % launch and post-launch support.
Tech Stack Flexibility I’m open to Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, or a custom solution—as long as it stays within budget and offers an intuitive admin panel. Let me know which platform you recommend and why.
Acceptance Criteria • Live, secure site on my domain with SSL enabled • Seamless checkout flow tested end-to-end • Responsive layout confirmed across major browsers/devices • Clear documentation and recorded walk-through for future edits
In your proposal, outline the platform you’d use, timeline, and how you’ll allocate each milestone against the total budget. Let’s build something that converts visitors into loyal customers.

item.title: Ongoing WordPress Site Maintenance
item.description:
15-25 AUD/hr | I need a reliable WordPress professional to keep my site running smoothly over the long term. Your main focus will be routine plugin updates and day-to-day content edits; I’ll simply reach out whenever a change is needed, rather than on a fixed weekly or monthly schedule.
There are no unusual plugins or custom content systems to worry about—just standard WordPress, so you should be comfortable working inside the normal dashboard, running safe backups, and testing updates on a staging copy before pushing live. Solid attention to uptime, page-speed, and basic security hygiene is important to me even though I’m not asking for a full security-monitoring package right now.
Deliverables I’ll be looking for: • Timely plugin updates applied without breaking existing functionality • Content tweaks (text, images, minor layout) turned around promptly on request • A quick note or brief changelog each time you’ve completed work so I can track what’s been done
If you have a dependable workflow for safe updates and can be responsive when tasks pop up, let’s get started.

item.title: 1960s Classic Car Sales Website
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I'm looking for a skilled web developer to create a vintage 1960s-themed classic car sales website. The site should showcase high-quality images of classic cars, provide detailed car information and history, and enable direct sales and payments.
Key Requirements: - Vintage 1960s design aesthetic - High-quality image galleries - Detailed car information and history - Direct sales and payment functionality
Ideal Skills & Experience: - Proven web development experience - Strong portfolio with vintage-themed sites - E-commerce integration expertise - Attention to detail and design
Please provide a portfolio and relevant experience in your bids

item.title: AI Platform for Distressed Deals
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I’m ready to invest in a custom AI-driven platform that takes a distressed real-estate lead from raw data all the way through a signed purchase agreement—always targeting properties in pre-foreclosure, tax delinquency, or other high-motivation situations so we can acquire them well below market value.
Core capabilities I need • Data ingestion and enrichment: pull fresh owner and property details from public records, mainstream real-estate databases, and any relevant third-party APIs. The system must de-duplicate records, flag high-priority leads, and keep the data refreshed automatically. • Predictive identification: use machine-learning models to score which owners are most likely to accept a discounted cash offer. Transparency on the factors driving each score is important so I can tweak my acquisition criteria. • Multi-channel outreach: once a lead is approved, the platform should launch pre-configured SMS, e-mail, ringless voicemail, and postcard campaigns, then track every touchpoint in one timeline. • Conversation automation: integrate a GPT-style conversational agent that can handle routine seller questions and book calls into my calendar while handing complex threads off to me or my acquisitions manager. • Negotiation & contract workflow: auto-populate offer numbers, generate state-specific purchase agreements, route them for e-signature, and store everything in a secure deal folder. • Deal pipeline dashboard: Kanban or similar view showing lead → offer → under contract → closed, with projected profit and time to close calculations. • Mobile first: a companion app for both iOS and Android so I can review comps, fire off messages, or sign docs on the go.
Acceptance criteria 1. End-to-end demo that starts with raw data import and finishes with a signed test contract. 2. Accuracy metrics for lead scoring and outreach delivery provided in a written report. 3. Source code, model notebooks, and setup scripts delivered in a private repository with clear README. 4. Deployment documents for both cloud hosting and App Store / Play Store submission.
If you have prior experience mingling AI, prop-tech data feeds, and transactional workflows, let’s talk about milestones and timelines—I’m ready to move quickly.

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
